# CONTOH LISTING PROGRAM INPUT SERPENT

```
% --- KLT-40S Assembly --------------------------------------
set title "KLT-40S"

% --- Fuel pin UO2 18.6wt% with Silumin Matrix:
surf 11 cyl 0.000 0.000 0.290 -60.00 60.00
surf 12 cyl 0.000 0.000 0.340 -60.00 60.00
cell 11 1 fuel -11     % fuel UO2 18.6wt% with Silumin Matrix
cell 12 1 clad 11 -12  % cladding zircaloy 0.5 mm
cell 13 1 water 12
```
